query: select s.name as serie, c.display_order as chapter_order, l.title as lesson_title, l.display_order as lesson_order, coalesce(length(l.content),0) as content_length, l.is_active as lesson_active, count(distinct e.id) as exercise_count, count(distinct eq.id) as exercise_question_count, count(distinct q.id) as quiz_count, count(distinct qq.id) as quiz_question_count, count(distinct qa.id) as quiz_answer_count, bool_and(coalesce(e.is_published,false)=false and coalesce(e.is_active,false)=false) as exercises_draft, bool_and(coalesce(q.is_published,false)=false and coalesce(q.is_active,false)=false) as quizzes_draft from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id left join public.exercises e on e.lesson_id=l.id left join public.exercise_questions eq on eq.exercise_id=e.id left join public.quizzes q on q.lesson_id=l.id left join public.quiz_questions qq on qq.quiz_id=q.id left join public.quiz_answers qa on qa.question_id=qq.id where sub.name='Histoire-Géographie' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2','C','D') and c.title='THÈME 1 — LA CÔTE D’IVOIRE : ÉTUDE ÉCONOMIQUE' and l.title in ('Leçon 1 — Les fondements du développement économique de la Côte d’Ivoire','Leçon 2 — Les secteurs d’activité économique de la Côte d’Ivoire','Leçon 3 — Les problèmes du développement économique de la Côte d’Ivoire') group by s.name,c.display_order,l.title,l.display_order,l.content,l.is_active order by s.name,l.display_order limit 20;
